reviews.name: Olivia G.
reviews.text: Kirk did a ton of work for us recently. Found him on Task Rabbit but reached out direct after such a good experience. Fair price and great reviews.

reviews.text: Great handyman! Called him for one of my listings and he was super helpful and reliable. Highly recommend his services.
